note: First version: the small capitals label over a heading that sheets, lessons and cards repeat

component.doc: An eyebrow: a small label in capitals over a heading, in one colour (what a sheet is about, a lesson's course, a card's kind): Caption text, SemiBold, in capitals (core://Text caps), in the accent colour unless color is given. For a quiet heading over a grouped card use core:section_label.

params.name: text
params.doc: The label, written as it should read (the app draws it in capitals); bindings allowed, such as $item.day evening.

params.name: color
params.doc: Its colour, such as ${local://theme#error} for something that needs fixing.

examples.note: over a sheet's title: which evening is being planned
over the title of something that needs fixing, in the error colour
over a lesson's title: where it sits in its course
